name: RiverGaugingObservation
description: A water-level reading from a river gauging station. Demonstrates observedProperty on the record type and the semanticRole values featureOfInterest, observingProcedure, observationValue, resultQuality, phenomenonTime, and resultTime.

stationId.description: National identifier of the gauging station whose water level is observed.

sensor.description: Instrument catalogue URI identifying the sensor and measurement procedure used to produce this reading.

waterLevel.description: Height of the water surface above the station datum.

qualityFlag.description: Quality classification assigned to this water-level reading by the data-processing system.

description.provisional: Automatically ingested and not yet reviewed; the value may change.
description.validated: Reviewed against the station record and accepted as final.
description.estimated: Filled by the processing system from neighbouring readings rather than measured.
description.suspect: Failed an automated range or rate-of-change test and should not be used without review.

measuredAt.description: Instant at which the stated water level applied at the station.

publishedAt.description: Instant at which the result became available from the data-processing system.
